newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade fairly active at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade fairly active at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active in Kansas on Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.00 higher than last week. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 16,300 slaughter steers and 20,200 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 57,600 head confirmed including 20,700 head or about 36 percent of previously contracted or formulated cattle.

Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 66.00, couple pens 65.00-65.50; small pen Select and Choice 1300 lb Holsteins 60.00. Dressed Basis Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1275 lbs 105.00-105.50.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1190 lbs 66.00, pen 975 lbs 65.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1250-1350 lb heifers and heiferettes 64.00-65.00. Dressed Basis Select
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
